# mixpanel_team_project_assignment (Resource)

Gives the members of a team access to a project. Teams have no public API, this uses the endpoints of the Mixpanel UI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mixpanel_team_project_assignment" "developers" {
  team_id    = mixpanel_team.developers.id
  project_id = mixpanel_project.myproject.id
  role       = "analyst"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (Number)
- `role` (String) Project role: `owner`, `admin`, `analyst` or `consumer`.
- `team_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<team_id>/<project_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Assignments can be imported by <team_id>/<project_id>.
terraform import mixpanel_team_project_assignment.developers 123/456
```
